8f071eb382.why: All four duplicated-word products and their copied results are live, and VPMULHRSW cannot fold the required dword broadcasts into its memory operand.

249c4b3fce.why: Each live result needs its word unpack and rounded multiplication with a separately broadcast runtime coefficient.

023da0e189.why: Each of the eight unpacks produces a distinct required final register value.

c476070d0f.why: All eight saturated sums and differences are required, with one instruction already producing each result.

f003fd973b.why: The broadcast, permutations, and arithmetic produce only dead results and perform no stores. Keeping VZEROUPPER preserves its effect on the only live vector register, zmm0.

ca5cc00292.why: Two load-permutations and two qword unpacks replace each six-instruction pair of broadcast-and-shuffle sequences, using only bytes originally loaded. The final ymm24 broadcast, zero stores, upper-vector clearing, and comparison are preserved.

21f7eacd76.why: Each result combines two separate 16-byte loads, and widening those loads would read gaps the original never loads.

e8b2cd5e9e.why: The separated 16-byte loads and their shuffles are needed for the live outputs, while the zeroing and all four stores must remain.

9b9eac30c4.why: The permutations, saturated butterflies, shuffles, and rounded products feed preserved values, and VZEROUPPER also has required effects on the low-numbered vector registers.

ce4d275e07.why: Both integer rounding stages are significant, and the store, rcx update, final scalar result, zero vector, and broadcast are all required.

e0b1b0c492.why: With arbitrary incoming zmm18 and zmm19, the unpack, wrapping word additions, and unsigned-saturating pack cannot be replaced by a simple byte addition.

f29720cc40.why: The runtime byte masks, rounded products, transpose stages, and final word unpacks all contribute to required register values.

26f0c5568e.why: All eight duplicated-word results are live and already require only one unpack instruction each.

ace2280918.why: All four rounded products and their copies are live, and their scalar coefficient broadcasts cannot be folded into VPMULHRSW.

b066bdfc46.why: Each of the eight live rounded products needs a distinct runtime coefficient broadcast that VPMULHRSW cannot directly fold.

d1f7a8918a.why: Each saturated sum and difference is a distinct live output already computed by one instruction.

ab95e6563f.why: Every unpack writes a required final register value, with no redundant or dead result.

825b9ffe4b.why: The four required high-word duplications each already use a single instruction.

3e8f4929c6.why: All sixteen lane-shuffle results are preserved and each is already generated by one instruction.

cb8fc4e9f8.why: The two rounded multiplication stages have significant intermediate truncation, and the store, rcx update, scalar result, and final shift flags must all match.
